jp_verse: 弱い声を　押しつぶす影\n\n    朝の草だけが　涙を知る
en_verse: A shadow crushes\nthe voice of the small—\nonly the morning grass remembers the tears.

jp_verse: 古い窓から　やわらかな光\n\n    赦しは　静かに部屋を満たす
en_verse: Soft light enters\nthrough the old window—\nforgiveness fills the room without sound.

jp_verse: 霧の野に　色はほどけ\n\n    境界だけが　風に残る
en_verse: In the misted field\nthe colors dissolve—\nonly faint boundaries remain in the wind.

jp_verse: 若葉ゆれる　淡い空の下\n\n    春は　一枚ずつ始まる
en_verse: Young leaves tremble\nbeneath the pale sky—\nspring begins one leaf at a time.

jp_verse: 木陰の絵は　本物に似て\n\n    けれど風までは　描けない
en_verse: The painted tree\nresembles the real one—\nbut it cannot capture the wind.

jp_verse: 遠い光が　水面ににじみ\n\n    答えは　まだ霧の向こう
en_verse: A distant light\nblurs upon the water—\nthe answer still hides beyond the mist.

jp_verse: 草に埋もれた　小さな石\n\n    名もなく　夕日に眠る
en_verse: A small stone\nburied among the grass—\nsleeping nameless in the evening light.

jp_verse: 畑を耕す　静かな手\n\n    暮らしは　土の匂いに続く
en_verse: Quiet hands till\nthe evening earth—\nlife continues in the scent of soil.

jp_verse: 光を映す　薄い円\n\n    触れれば　世界は消えてしまう
en_verse: A fragile circle\nreflects the light—\none touch and the world disappears.

jp_verse: 小さな芽が　土を押し上げ\n\n    未来は　まだ柔らかい
en_verse: A tiny sprout\npushes through the soil—\nthe future is still soft.

jp_verse: ひび割れた甲羅に\n\n    見えない時代の　足音が響く
en_verse: Within the cracked shell\nechoes the footstep\nof an unseen age.

jp_verse: 桃の花咲く　春の道\n\n    風まで　淡く色づいていた
en_verse: Along the spring road\npeach blossoms bloom—\neven the wind carries color.

jp_verse: 馬は遠くを　見つめたまま\n\n    沈む雲だけが　ゆっくり流れる
en_verse: The horse keeps staring\ninto the distance—\nonly the clouds drift slowly by.

jp_verse: 黒い犬が　静かに座り\n\n    帰る足音を　待っている
en_verse: The black dog sits\nwithout a sound—\nwaiting for familiar footsteps.

jp_verse: 眠る犬たちの　変わらぬ輪\n\n    時だけが　そっと通り過ぎる
en_verse: The circle of resting dogs\nnever seems to change—\nonly time passes quietly through.

jp_verse: 言葉を閉じた　黒い犬\n\n    沈黙だけが　隣に座る
en_verse: The black dog\nwears its silence gently—\nspeech remains outside the room.

jp_verse: 火はただ　静かに燃えて\n\n    理由もなく　夜を照らした
en_verse: The fire burns\nwithout explanation—\nsimply illuminating the night.

jp_verse: 風に揺れる　白い穂先\n\n    秋は　声より先に訪れる
en_verse: White reeds sway\nbefore the autumn wind—\nthe season arrives before its voice.

jp_verse: 獣を追う　黒い影\n\n    森はまだ　何も語らない
en_verse: A dark hunter\nmoves through the forest—\nthe woods reveal nothing yet.

jp_verse: 夕暮れの猫は　まっすぐ座り\n\n    世界を　少しだけ見下ろしていた
en_verse: At dusk the cat sits\nperfectly still—\nlooking slightly down upon the world.
